paite: Na lak uah kingaihna nin a-om chih thu athang vengvung hi. Huchibang kingaihna nin Zentelte lak a leng om ngei lou, na lak ua mi khat in amah pa zi akitenpih hi.
heading: Numei Pasal Thangtatna
english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.

paite: Huai thilhihpa na lak ua kipan delhkhiak ding a lungngaih nak sang in na kisaktheihpih zaw uhi.
english: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

paite: Kei mahmah pumpi in ka pang kei na a, kha in noute lak ah ka om a, thil huchi tel hihpa tu in leng Toupa Jesu min in na lak ua pang bang a kingaihtuah in thupukna ka bawlta hi.
english: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.

paite: I Toupa Jesu Khrist min a na kikhop chiang un, noute lak ah kha in ka om a, Toupa Jesu Khrist thilhihtheihna leng a-om hi.
english: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

paite: Mi huchibang zaw Toupa ni chiang a akha hotdam a a-omtheihna ding in asa hihmang ding in Setan kiang ah pekhia un.
english: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

paite: Na kisaktheihna uh hoih lou ahi. Silngou tawmchik in tanghou beu apum in azelsuak chih na thei kei ua hia?
english: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

paite: Silngou pang lou na hih mah bang un tanghou beu thak na hong hihtheihna ding un silngou lui pen paikhe siang un. I Paikan Ankuangluina ding Khrist latkhiak in a-omta hi.
english: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

paite: Huaiziak in ankuanglui ni, silngou lui a ankuang lui lou in, nunsia leh gitlouhna silngou a leng ankuang lui sam lou in, takna leh thutak tanghou silngou soh louh in ankuang i lui zaw ding uh.
english: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

paite: Ka laikhak ah kingaihhatte kithuahpih lou ding in na kiang uah ka gelh hi.
english: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

paite: Hiai khovel a kingaihhatte hiam, huaiham leh lepgute hiam, milim bete hiam kithuahpih het louh ding chi ka hi kei a; huchibang hileh khovel a kipan na paikhiak uh kul ding ahi.
english: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.

paite: Tu'n bel kuapeuh unau min po ngal in, kingaihhatmi hiam, mihuaiham hiam, milim bemi hiam, mihuaiham hiam, milim bemi hiam, hanhatmi hiam, zukham hatmi hiam, lepgumi hiam hileh, kithuahpih lou ding in na kiang uah ka gelh ahi; mi huchibang kiang ah nek leng ne kei un.
english: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.

paite: Polam mite tung a vaihawm ding ke'n bang ahia ka awlmoh ding om? Nou sung a mite hilou hia na ngaihtuah ding uh?
english: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?

paite: Polam a mite tung a Pathian in vaihawm hilou hia? “Huai migiloupa na lak ua kipan koihkhia un."
english: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”
